goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The plot auto-claimed (plots_claimed 1, auto_claims 1) and cash rose steadily. The playtester bought Dropper 2, Silver Ore and Speed 1 from the shop and Dropper 3 and Cash x1.5 from walk-on pads. Two shop Buy buttons (Cash x1.5 and Gold Ore) repeatedly did nothing despite enough cash, and the TOP TYCOONS board was never looked at in the trace, though the leaderboard_refresh counter ran.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' button on Gold Ore card never fires
bugs.evidence: Steps 10, 12, 13 and 16: pressing Card_tier_gold.State (by path and by text 'Buy', at 739,744) returned 'button did NOT fire'. Cash was 719 to 1.7K against a $500 price. shop_purchases stayed at 3, the card still showed 'Buy', and no 'not enough cash' or other message appeared. Other cards (Dropper 2, Silver Ore, Speed 1) bought fine. The card sits near the bottom edge of the panel and may be clipped or covered by the scroll frame.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' button for Cash x1.5 did not fire while the walk-on pad worked
bugs.evidence: Steps 7 and 8: pressing Card_mult1.State ('Buy', $300) at 739,640 with cash 335 and 467 returned 'button did NOT fire'. The same upgrade bought fine by touching UpgradePad_mult1 at step 11 (HUD 'Upgraded: Cash x1.5' at step 12). Shop and pad purchase paths behave inconsistently, and the shop gave no feedback.

bugs.title: No feedback when a shop purchase or rebirth is refused
bugs.evidence: Failed shop Buy presses (steps 7, 8, 10, 12, 13, 16) show no message. Rebirth at $5000 (steps 4, 9, 14; rebirth_denied 3) gives only a brief 'Not ready to rebirth' with no stated requirement. A new player cannot tell why nothing happened.

bugs.title: Tutorial re-shows repeatedly
bugs.evidence: The tutorial_reshown counter reached 49 within one short session while tutorial_steps stayed at 4, so the tutorial prompt appears to re-trigger constantly and may be annoying.

bugs.title: HUD still shows 'Ore: Bronze' after buying Silver Ore
bugs.evidence: Step 3 pressed Buy on Card_tier_silver and tier_upgrades=1 was counted, but the HUD summary in steps 4 to 17 still reads 'Ore: Bronze'. This could be a stale or wrong HUD value, or the label may mean something else. The observation text is truncated, so this is unconfirmed.
